replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
Golden: just an abbreviation of my username :3
Goldie: I personally like this one the best just because I find it to have a ring to it xP  On one of my first servers, I met and Skyped this hilarious dude who used to call me "Goldie Locks". I personally really like it xD
Bacon: This name is only in-real-life. During an art project, the teacher told us to make graffiti on a piece of paper. She said to choose a word that was close to you, specifically a nick-name, and put it into a special font. I chose "BACON" because I was new to that school and everyone in that area, in fact, and I had no nick-names because no one knew me. I didn't think of any names to choose, so I just chose something I knew and loved: bacon. Then, after that, basically everyone I knew and didn't know called me bacon. Pretty epic xD
